e.title: **把「用邮件寄来的收费目录」接成 FHIR 术语表**：奥地利 **ELGA** 的 **HoKUS** 流水线——**输入是**寄到 GitLab Service Desk 的 CSV／XLSX 附件**，**输出是**FHIR CodeSystem 与 spreadCT 工作簿**，**再由 CI 自动向术语服务器提合并请求**；**⭐ 每条概念码是**内容哈希**（**SHA-256 取 128 位**），**故同一份内容永远得到同一个码、**版本一改码就跟着改**；**⭐ 每 5 分钟自动跑一次**
e.title_en: Turning fee catalogues that arrive by email into FHIR terminology: the HoKUS pipeline at ELGA in Austria takes CSV or XLSX attachments sent to a GitLab Service Desk as input and produces FHIR CodeSystems and spreadCT workbooks, with continuous integration opening a merge request against the terminology server automatically; every concept code is a content hash of 128 bits taken from SHA-256, so identical content always yields the same code and any change of version yields a different one, and the whole pipeline re-runs every five minutes.
e.title_hk: **把「用電郵寄來的收費目錄」接成 FHIR 術語表**：奧地利 **ELGA** 的 **HoKUS** 流水線——**輸入是**寄到 GitLab Service Desk 的 CSV／XLSX 附件**，**輸出是**FHIR CodeSystem 與 spreadCT 工作簿**，**再由 CI 自動向術語伺服器提合併請求**；**⭐ 每條概念碼是**內容雜湊**（**SHA-256 取 128 位**），**故同一份內容永遠得到同一個碼、**版本一改碼就跟著改**；**⭐ 每 5 分鐘自動跑一次**
e.summary: **HoKUS**（`elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`，GitLab）**是奥地利电子健康机构 **ELGA** 旗下的一条术语流水线**，**逐字标题为**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」，**README 实测 11,140 字节**、**许可 GPL-3.0**（**仓库根 `LICENSE` 正文前几行为** GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3**）**、**创建 2026-07-29**、**最后活动 2026-09-07**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「同源多形」**，**它把「多形」的**两端**都写清了**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 输入是**别人寄来的异构表格****——**两个 CI 作业逐字为**「**dispatch-service-desk**」**（**取回 Service Desk、**把最新的 CSV／XLSX 附件存进 `input/`、**并取出寄件人域名**）与**「**process-catalog**」**；**触发器逐字**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**⭐ 而输入格式逐字列出**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」**与**「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」，**并给出一张**列名别名表**（**如** `gueltig_ab`／`Gültig ab`／`Gültig_ab`、`rueckerstattung`／`Rückerstattung`，**逐字说明**「**case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 输出是标准术语**——**FHIR CodeSystem**（**实测 `terminology/` 下四个 `.4.fhir.json`**：**`fachgebiet`（专业领域）、`versicherungstraeger`（保险机构）、`bundesland`（联邦州）、`status-verrechenbarkeit`（可结算状态）**）**与** spreadCT 工作簿**（**逐字**`meta`／`data` **两个工作表＋可选** `errors`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念码是**内容哈希**——**逐字**「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」**、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**，**且**版本键**逐字为** `fachgebiet`＋`positionsnummer`＋`gueltig_ab` **三个字段**「**always included in the hash**」**；**⭐⭐ ④ 写完就提合并请求**（**仓库根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，**CI 变量逐字含** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"` **与** `TERMGIT_TARGET_BRANCH: "main"`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未运行该流水线、未读任何脚本正文、未打开任何 FHIR 文件全集**。
e.summary_hk: **HoKUS**（`elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`，GitLab）**是奧地利電子健康機構 **ELGA** 旗下的一條術語流水線**，**逐字標題為**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」，**README 實測 11,140 位元組**、**許可 GPL-3.0**、**建立 2026-07-29**、**最後活動 2026-09-07**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「同源多形」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 輸入是**別人寄來的異構表格****——**兩個 CI 作業逐字為**「**dispatch-service-desk**」**與**「**process-catalog**」**；**觸發器逐字**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**輸入格式逐字列出**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」**與**「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」，**並給出一張**列名別名表**（**逐字說明**「**case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 輸出是標準術語**——**FHIR CodeSystem**（**實測 `terminology/` 下四個 `.4.fhir.json`**：`fachgebiet`／`versicherungstraeger`／`bundesland`／`status-verrechenbarkeit`**）**與** spreadCT 工作簿**（**逐字** `meta`／`data` **＋可選** `errors`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念碼是**內容雜湊**——**逐字**「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」**、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**，**版本鍵**逐字為** `fachgebiet`＋`positionsnummer`＋`gueltig_ab`**；**⭐⭐ ④ 寫完就提合併請求**（**倉庫根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，**CI 變數逐字含** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行該流水線、未讀任何腳本正文**。
e.summary_en: **HoKUS**, in the GitLab tree of the Austrian electronic health organisation ELGA, **is a terminology pipeline** titled verbatim as an import pipeline for fee catalogues that generates FHIR CodeSystems; its README measures 11,140 bytes, it is licensed GPL-3.0, created 2026-07-29 and last active 2026-09-07. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and the pipeline writes down both ends.** The input is heterogeneous spreadsheets sent by other organisations: two continuous integration jobs fetch a Service Desk inbox, save the newest CSV or XLSX attachment into an input directory and extract the sender domain, then process the catalogue; the trigger is a pipeline schedule every five minutes; and the accepted formats are listed verbatim with an alias table for column names and a note about case-insensitive handling of umlauts. The output is standard terminology: four FHIR CodeSystems covering medical specialty, insurance carrier, federal state and billability status, plus a spreadCT workbook with a metadata sheet, a data sheet and an optional errors sheet. **Every concept code is a content hash**: SHA-256 truncated to 128 bits and rendered in Base64URL, about twenty-two characters, over a canonical representation with fixed field order, a special null token and UTF-8 encoding, with a version key of specialty, position number and valid-from date that is always included. **And the result is proposed upstream automatically**: the repository carries a script that opens a merge request against the terminology server, with the target project and branch configured in the pipeline. **The pipeline was not run this round, no script body was read, and no FHIR file was opened in full.**
e.body:
**HoKUS**（**GitLab 仓库** `elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`）**是奥地利电子健康机构 **ELGA** 的术语工具组里的一条流水线**，**逐字标题为**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」（**收费目录导入流水线：生成 FHIR CodeSystem**）**。**本次实测**：**★0**、**fork 1**、**创建 2026-07-29**、**最后活动 2026-09-07**、**默认分支 `main`**、**许可 GPL-3.0**（**仓库根 `LICENSE` 正文逐字为** GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3**）**；**README 实测 11,140 字节**；**仓库文件清单实测 15 条**：`readme.md`、`dispatcher.py`、`tarif_to_spreadct.py`、`non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`、`create_termgit_mr.py`、`requirements.txt`（**逐字为** `pandas`、`openpyxl`、`requests`**）**、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、`.env.example`、`.gitignore`、`LICENSE`、**以及** `terminology/` **下四个 FHIR JSON**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**同源多形：一份内容、好几种形态，且必须对得上**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、文件清单、`.gitlab-ci.yml` 与一个 CodeSystem 全文实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 输入端是「别人寄来的表格」，而且写清了为什么难**——**README 逐字给出两个作业**：**「**1. **dispatch-service-desk**: Fetches the Service Desk, saves the latest CSV/XLSX attachment to the `input/` directory, and extracts the sender domain.**」**与**「**2. **process-catalog**: Processes the tariff file with `tarif_to_spreadct.py` and generates a domain-specific spreadCT output file.**」**；**⭐ 数据来源是**邮件**（**逐字**「**Send an email to the project’s Service Desk address. Attach a CSV or XLSX file with tariff data.**」**）**，**触发器逐字为**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**⭐ 输入格式逐字为**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」与「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」**，**README 另附一张**列名别名表**（**左列为规范名、右列为别名**，**逐字说明**「**The program recognizes the following columns (case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts)**」**；**本次实读到的别名含** `gueltig_ab` ← `Gueltig_ab, Gültig ab, Gültig_ab`；`rueckerstattung` ← `Rueckerstattung, Rückerstattung`；`geldleisterbetrag` ← `Geldleisterbetrag, Geldleisterbetr?ge`（**该行在 README 里带一个编码损坏字符，本词条以问号代替并如实标注**）**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它没有说「我们支持各种格式」，而是把**接受的编码**、**取哪一张工作表**、**列名的各种叫法**逐个写出来**——**⭐ 即**「**异构**」被具体化成了可以对照的清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 输出端是标准术语，而且产物是可数的几样**——**`terminology/` 下实测四个 FHIR 资源文件**（**文件名为** `CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-fachgebiet.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-versicherungstraeger.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-bundesland.4.fhir.json`、`CodeSystem-honorarkataloge-status-verrechenbarkeit.4.fhir.json`**）**；**⭐ 本次打开其中一个（`versicherungstraeger`）实测其头部字段**：**`resourceType` 为** `CodeSystem`、**`url` 逐字为** `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-versicherungstraeger`、**`version` 逐字为** `0.3.0+20251010`、**`status` 为** `draft`、**`date` 为** `2025-10-10`、**`content` 为** `complete`、**`count` 与 `concept` 数量均为** 50（**即** 50 家保险机构**）**；**⭐ 另一产物是** spreadCT 工作簿**，**逐字**「**The output file contains at least two worksheets: meta — Transposed metadata (key-value pairs)；data — Concepts with CodeSystem properties**」**，**并逐字说明可选的第三张**「**errors — Validation errors and warnings**」**。**⭐ 即**输出文件**自己带一张错误表**——**⭐ 与本站第 338／343 轮记下的「**机器可读的产物要自带不确定性的位置**」同形**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念码不是编号，而是**内容哈希****——README 有专节逐字标题**「**Content-Based Codes (Non-Semantic)**」**，**并逐字给出**：**「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」**、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**；**并逐字说明**版本键**：**「**A tariff version is uniquely identified by the combination of: `fachgebiet` (medical specialty)`／`positionsnummer` (position number)`／`gueltig_ab` (valid from date). These three fields are **always** included in the hash. Changes to any of them produce a different concept code.**」**；**另逐字列出**参与哈希的 18 个字段**（**fachgebiet、positionsnummer、gueltig_ab、traegercode、leistungsart、leistungsgruppe、leistungskategorie、bezeichnung_kurztext、bezeichnung_langtext、bundesland、tarif、rueckerstattung、geldleisterbetrag、status_verrechenbarkeit、privattarif、beschreibungstext、dauer_der_leistung、flags**）**与**两个可选字段**（**`hono_id` 需 `--include-hono-id`、`gueltig_bis` 需 `--include-dates`**）**；**CLI 选项逐字含** `--include-hono-id`、`--include-dates`、`--hash-bits 256`、`--trim-strings`（**逐字注明**「**default: enabled**」**）、`--lowercase-hash-input`；**README 另用一张四行表说明**「**Different Versions Produce Different Codes**」**（**同位置号不同生效日、不同专业领域、不同位置号各得不同码**）**。**⭐ 即**同一份内容**永远得到同一个码**（**可复核：拿原表重算即可**），**而**内容或生效期一改**，**码就跟着变**（**不必依赖某个中心的分配表**）——**⭐ 这正是「同源多形」里的**一致性问题**：**多份来源、多次导入，怎么保证「同一条项目」不被重复登记或错误合并。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 产物会**自动被提出去**——**仓库根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，**而 `.gitlab-ci.yml`（实测 6,768 字节）逐字含变量** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"`、`TERMGIT_TARGET_BRANCH: "main"`、**以及** `TERMGIT_MR_REVIEWERS`（**逐字注释**「**Reviewer usernames (comma-separated, e.g., "user1,user2,user3")**」**）**——**⭐ 即**流水线跑完会**向术语仓库（termgit）开一个合并请求**，**并由人复核后才并入**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ CI 本身也交代了它的阶段与容错**——`.gitlab-ci.yml` **逐字给出四阶段** `stages: .pre / test / dispatch-process-mr / analyze`；**默认镜像** `python:3.12-slim`；**两个全局变量逐字为** `PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"` 与 `PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR: "1"`；**作业** `py-compile` **逐字列出四个脚本名**（`dispatcher.py`、`tarif_to_spreadct.py`、`non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`、`create_termgit_mr.py`），**另一个作业** `type-check` **带** `allow_failure: true`（**⭐ 即**类型检查**允许失败而不拦流水线**）**；**两个作业都带** `retry: max: 2` **且限定在** `runner_system_failure` **与** `stuck_or_timeout_failure` **两种情形**（**⭐ 即**只重试**基础设施故障**，**不重试**代码错误**）。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 输出端的规范 URL 与序列化格式也被写明**——README 逐字给出四张 CodeSystem 的规范 URL（**前缀均为** `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-`）**，**并逐字给出编码序列化格式**「**system|version|code|display**」**与一个例子**：`https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-bundesland|0.3.0+20251010|3|Burgenland`。**⭐ 即**「**一条编码长什么样**」**在这里是可以逐字对照的**（**并与本次实测的那份 CodeSystem 版本号一致**）。**⚠️ 本次实测到两处**文档与仓库不一致**（**如实记录、不推测原因**）**：**① README 把生成非语义标识的模块写作** `non_sem_content_based_id_creator.py`**，**而仓库里的实际文件名是** `non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`（**CI 的 `py-compile` 作业逐字用的是后者**）；**② README 的别名表里有一处编码损坏字符**（**本次以问号代替**）**。**⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]] 记录的是保险业数据标准的组织与架构层**，**[[omop-common-data-model]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[icd-r]] 覆盖医疗数据与编码映射**，**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、[[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[kokuho-rules-engine]] 覆盖「把表单／规则转成机器可读」的相邻做法**，**而本条补上的是**「**用内容哈希给术语发稳定标识，并在 CI 里自动向上游术语服务器提合并请求**」这一组合**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[omop-common-data-model]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**异构来源 → 标准术语**」这件事的一个完整流水线样本**：**输入端把编码与列名逐一列出、输出端给出规范 URL 与序列化格式、标识用内容哈希而不是顺序号、产物自带错误表、最后由 CI 提合并请求给人复核**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该流水线**（**未发过任何邮件、未配置任何 CI 变量、未跑任何作业、未生成任何 spreadCT 或 CodeSystem**），**故不主张**该流水线按所述工作、不主张其产物可用、也不主张那些 CodeSystem 当前的状态。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 Python 脚本正文**——**本次只读了** `readme.md`（11,140 字节）、`.gitlab-ci.yml`（6,768 字节）、**文件清单、`requirements.txt` 全文**，**以及** **一个** CodeSystem **JSON 的头部字段**，**故不主张**导入与哈希的实际实现、异常处理、以及 `create_termgit_mr.py` 开 MR 的具体方式。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实哈希实现的正确性**：**未运行任何一次哈希、未对照任何已知输入输出**；**⭐ 本词条只记录「文档如此描述」与「字段清单如此」**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实那四个 CodeSystem 的实际内容**（**只完整打开了一个的头部、并看到其 `concept` 数量为 50**），**其余三个本次未打开**；**未核实其 `status` 为 `draft` 是否意味着尚未被正式采用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** termgit **是否就是 ELGA 的正式术语服务器、未访问该域名、未核实项目 ID** `33179072` **指向何处**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 ELGA 的机构性质与该项目在其中的正式地位**（**本次只读到组织路径与 README**）；**★0／fork 1 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 GPL-3.0（本次读到 `LICENSE` 正文前几行）**，**未读全文**；**⚠️ 本词条不对 GPL 对术语数据适用性的影响作任何判断**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-07-29 在解冻窗口之外、最后活动 2026-09-07 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把异构收费目录经内容哈希转成标准术语、并在 CI 里自动向上游提合并请求**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文与德文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（`project’s` 一处）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

e.body_hk:
**HoKUS**（**GitLab 倉庫** `elga-gmbh/terminologit/term-tools/hokus`）**是奧地利電子健康機構 **ELGA** 的術語工具組裡的一條流水線**，**逐字標題為**「**Honorarkataloge Import Pipeline for FHIR CodeSystem Generation**」。**本次實測**：**★0**、**fork 1**、**建立 2026-07-29**、**最後活動 2026-09-07**、**預設分支 `main`**、**許可 GPL-3.0**；**README 實測 11,140 位元組**；**文件清單實測 15 條**，**含** `dispatcher.py`、`tarif_to_spreadct.py`、`non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`、`create_termgit_mr.py`、`requirements.txt`（**逐字為** `pandas`、`openpyxl`、`requests`**）**、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、`LICENSE` **與** `terminology/` **下四個 FHIR JSON**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**同源多形：一份內容、好幾種形態，且必須對得上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、文件清單、`.gitlab-ci.yml` 與一個 CodeSystem 全文實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 輸入端是「別人寄來的表格」**——**兩個作業逐字為**「**dispatch-service-desk**: Fetches the Service Desk, saves the latest CSV/XLSX attachment to the `input/` directory, and extracts the sender domain.**」**與**「**process-catalog**: Processes the tariff file with `tarif_to_spreadct.py` and generates a domain-specific spreadCT output file.**」**；**資料來源是**電郵**（**逐字**「**Send an email to the project’s Service Desk address.**」**）**，**觸發器逐字**「**Every 5 minutes via Pipeline Schedule**」**；**輸入格式逐字為**「**CSV (UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, cp1252)**」**與**「**XLSX (first non-empty sheet with header row)**」，**並附一張**列名別名表**（**逐字**「**case-insensitive, robust handling of umlauts**」**；**實讀到的別名含** `Gueltig_ab, Gültig ab, Gültig_ab` **與** `Rueckerstattung, Rückerstattung`；**其中一行帶一個編碼損壞字元，本詞條以問號代替並如實標註**）**。**⭐ 即**「**異構**」被具體化成可對照的清單**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 輸出端是標準術語**——`terminology/` 下實測四個 FHIR 資源檔（`fachgebiet`／`versicherungstraeger`／`bundesland`／`status-verrechenbarkeit`）；**⭐ 本次打開其中一個實測頭部**：`url` 逐字為 `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-versicherungstraeger`、`version` 逐字為 `0.3.0+20251010`、**`status` 為** `draft`、**`date` 為** `2025-10-10`、**`count` 與 `concept` 數量均為** 50（**即** 50 家保險機構**）**；**另一產物是** spreadCT 工作簿**（**逐字** `meta`／`data` **兩表＋可選** `errors`**）**——**⭐ 即**輸出檔自帶一張錯誤表**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 概念碼不是編號，而是**內容雜湊****——**逐字**：「**Algorithm: SHA-256**」、**「**Length: 128 bits (Base64URL, approx. 22 characters)**」**、**「**Canonical representation: Fixed field order, special NULL token, UTF-8 encoding**」**；**版本鍵逐字為** `fachgebiet`＋`positionsnummer`＋`gueltig_ab`（**逐字**「**always included in the hash**」**）**；**另逐字列出參與雜湊的 18 個欄位與兩個可選欄位**，**CLI 選項含** `--include-hono-id`、`--include-dates`、`--hash-bits 256`、`--trim-strings`、`--lowercase-hash-input`。**⭐ 即**同一份內容**永遠得到同一個碼**，**內容或生效期一改碼就變**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 產物會**自動被提出去**——**倉庫根有** `create_termgit_mr.py`，`.gitlab-ci.yml` **逐字含** `TERMGIT_PROJECT_ID: "33179072"`、`TERMGIT_TARGET_BRANCH: "main"`、`TERMGIT_MR_REVIEWERS`。**⭐⭐ ⑤ CI 交代了階段與容錯**——**四階段逐字為** `.pre / test / dispatch-process-mr / analyze`；**預設鏡像** `python:3.12-slim`；**作業** `py-compile` **逐字列出四個腳本名**，`type-check` **帶** `allow_failure: true`；**兩個作業都限定只重試** `runner_system_failure` **與** `stuck_or_timeout_failure`（**⭐ 即**只重試基礎設施故障，**不重試程式錯誤**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 輸出端規範 URL 與序列化格式也被寫明**——**逐字給出四張 CodeSystem 的 URL 前綴**與序列化格式**「**system|version|code|display**」**，**例子為** `https://termgit.elga.gv.at/CodeSystem/honorarkataloge-bundesland|0.3.0+20251010|3|Burgenland`。**⚠️ 本次實測到兩處**文件與倉庫不一致**（**如實記錄、不推測原因**）**：**① README 把生成非語意標識的模組寫作** `non_sem_content_based_id_creator.py`**，**實際檔名是** `non_sem_but_content_based_id_creator.py`；**② 別名表裡有一處編碼損壞字元**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[omop-common-data-model]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「**異構來源 → 標準術語**」這件事的一個完整流水線樣本**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該流水線**（**未發過任何郵件、未配置任何 CI 變數、未跑任何作業、未生成任何產物**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 Python 腳本正文**——**只讀了** `readme.md`、`.gitlab-ci.yml`、**文件清單、`requirements.txt` 全文**，**與** **一個** CodeSystem **的頭部欄位**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實雜湊實作的正确性**（**未運行任何一次雜湊**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核實四個 CodeSystem 的實際內容**（**只完整打開一個的頭部**）；**未核實 `status: draft` 是否意味尚未正式採用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** termgit **是否為 ELGA 的正式術語伺服器、未訪問該域名、未核實專案 ID** `33179072`。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實 ELGA 的機構性質與該專案在其中的正式地位**；**★0／fork 1 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 GPL-3.0（本次讀到 `LICENSE` 正文前幾行）**，**未讀全文**；**不對 GPL 對術語資料適用性的影響作任何判斷**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-07-29 在解凍窗口之外、最後活動 2026-09-07 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把異構收費目錄經內容雜湊轉成標準術語、並在 CI 裡自動向上游提合併請求」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文與德文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`project’s`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

## 同類工具
[[irs-actuarial-tables-processor]]、[[japan-egov-law-api]]、[[raidiam-open-insurance-conformance]]
e.body_en:
**HoKUS**, in the GitLab group tree of the Austrian electronic health organisation ELGA, **is a terminology pipeline**, titled verbatim as an import pipeline for fee catalogues that generates FHIR CodeSystems. **Measured this round**: **zero stars**, **one fork**, **created 2026-07-29**, **last active 2026-09-07**, **default branch `main`**, **licensed GPL-3.0** with the licence file beginning with version 3 of the GNU General Public License; **the README measures 11,140 bytes**; and **the file listing measures fifteen entries**, holding four Python scripts, a requirements file listing pandas, openpyxl and requests, a pipeline definition, an environment example, a licence and four FHIR JSON files under a terminology directory. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one source taking several forms, and of those forms having to agree.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the file listing, the pipeline definition and a full read of one CodeSystem**: **first, the input end is spreadsheets sent in by other organisations, and the difficulty is written out rather than summarised.** The README states the two jobs verbatim: one fetches the Service Desk, saves the newest CSV or XLSX attachment into an input directory and extracts the sender domain; the other processes the tariff file and generates a domain-specific spreadCT output file. **The data arrives by email** — verbatim, send an email to the project Service Desk address and attach a CSV or XLSX file with tariff data — **and the pipeline runs on a schedule every five minutes.** The accepted formats are listed verbatim, a CSV in UTF-8, UTF-8 with a byte order mark, or the older Windows code page, and an XLSX taking the first non-empty sheet with a header row; **and the README carries a table of column-name aliases, described verbatim as case-insensitive with robust handling of umlauts**, listing for example three spellings that all map to a valid-from column and two spellings that map to a reimbursement column, **with one alias row damaged by an encoding artefact, which this entry renders with a question mark and notes as such**. **Heterogeneity is thereby made into a checklist you can compare against, rather than a claim of supporting many formats.** **Second, the output end is standard terminology, and the artefacts are countable.** The terminology directory holds four FHIR resources covering medical specialty, insurance carrier, federal state and billability status. **Opening one of them this round shows a CodeSystem whose URL points at a terminology server under the ELGA domain, whose version reads as a semantic version followed by a date, whose status is draft, whose content is complete and whose concept count is fifty** — fifty insurance carriers. The other artefact is a spreadCT workbook, described verbatim as containing at least two worksheets, one holding transposed key-value metadata and one holding concepts with their CodeSystem properties, **plus an optional third sheet that holds validation errors and warnings**, so the output file carries its own uncertainty rather than hiding it. **Third, the concept code is not a running number but a content hash.** A dedicated section lists the algorithm as SHA-256, the length as 128 bits rendered in Base64URL at about twenty-two characters, and the canonical representation as a fixed field order with a special null token and UTF-8 encoding; a version is uniquely identified by the combination of medical specialty, position number and valid-from date, and those three fields are always included in the hash, so a change to any of them produces a different concept code; eighteen further fields participate by default, with a hono identifier and an end date available through command-line switches, and a four-row table demonstrates that different specialties, positions or valid-from dates all yield different codes. **Identical content therefore always yields the same code, reproducible by anyone who recomputes the hash, while any change of content or period yields a different one without depending on a central allocation table** — which is exactly the consistency problem behind several sources and repeated imports, namely keeping one item from being registered twice or merged by mistake. **Fourth, the result is proposed upstream automatically**: the repository carries a script that opens a merge request, and the pipeline definition names the target project identifier, the target branch and an optional comma-separated reviewer list, so a human still reviews before anything is merged. **Fifth, the pipeline states its own stages and its tolerance for failure**: four stages, a slim Python 3.12 default image, two pip environment variables disabling version checks and caching, one job that compiles the four scripts by name, and a type-checking job marked as allowed to fail; both jobs retry only on runner system failure and on being stuck or timing out, **so infrastructure failures are retried and code errors are not**. **Sixth, the canonical URLs and the serialisation format are written down**, with the format given as system, version, code and display joined by pipes, and an example that matches the version string measured in the file. **Two mismatches between documentation and repository were measured**: the README names the identifier module without the extra word that the actual filename carries, and the pipeline compiles the real filename; and one alias row contains a damaged character. **Both are recorded without speculation about cause.** **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: `[[acord]]` and `[[acord-mcp-architecture]]` cover standards organisations and architectures, `[[omop-common-data-model]]`, `[[icd-hcc-mappings]]` and `[[icd-r]]` cover medical coding and mappings, and `[[medical-opinion-extractor]]`, `[[vhis-standard-premium]]` and `[[kokuho-rules-engine]]` cover adjacent form-and-rule conversions, while this entry supplies the combination of stable content-hash identifiers for terminology and continuous integration that opens a merge request upstream.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[icd-hcc-mappings]] and [[omop-common-data-model]]**, because **it is a complete pipeline sample of heterogeneous sources becoming standard terminology**: the input end lists encodings and column aliases one by one, the output end gives canonical URLs and a serialisation format, identity is a content hash rather than a sequence number, the artefact carries its own error sheet, and continuous integration proposes the result for human review.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the pipeline was not run** — no email was sent, no pipeline variable was configured, no job was executed and no spreadCT or CodeSystem was generated — **so the pipeline is not claimed to work as described, its output is not claimed usable, and the current state of those CodeSystems is not claimed**. **Second, no Python script body was read**: only the README, the pipeline definition, the file listing, the requirements file in full and the header of one CodeSystem were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual import and hashing implementations, their error handling, or how the merge request is opened; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the correctness of the hash implementation was not verified**, no hash was computed and no known input-output pair was compared; **this entry records only that the documentation describes it this way and that the field list reads as shown**. **Fourth, the contents of the four CodeSystems were not verified**, only one header was read in full, and whether draft status means not yet formally adopted was not established. **Fifth, whether the terminology server domain is ELGA official terminology service was not verified**, the domain was not visited and the target project identifier was not resolved. **Sixth, the institutional nature of ELGA and the formal status of this project within it were not researched**, and zero stars with one fork is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, the licence is GPL-3.0 as read in the first lines of the licence file, whose full text was not read**, and no judgement is offered on how that licence bears on terminology data. **Eighth, the creation date of 2026-07-29 is outside the thaw window while the last activity of 2026-09-07 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that turning heterogeneous fee catalogues into standard terminology through content-hash identifiers and proposing the result upstream from continuous integration had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in quoted English and German were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
